name: Deep Learning
description: Machine learning with multi-layer neural networks, such as convolutional and recurrent networks and transformers, trained on large data sets for tasks like image recognition, language understanding and prediction.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Methods that let computers analyse, understand and generate human language, such as text classification, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, translation and chatbots.

name: Computer Vision
description: Methods that let computers interpret images and video, such as object detection, image classification, segmentation and face recognition.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Building computer systems that perform tasks needing human intelligence, such as reasoning, learning, planning, perception and language understanding.

name: OpenCV
description: The open-source computer vision library OpenCV, used to process images and video, detect objects and faces, and build vision applications in Python or C++.

name: SQLite
description: The lightweight embedded relational database SQLite, used to store and query data with SQL inside desktop, mobile and small web applications.

name: Cypress
description: The JavaScript end-to-end testing framework Cypress, used to write automated browser tests for web applications.

name: User Experience Design
description: Designing how people use a product, including user research, wireframes, prototypes, user interface design and usability testing.

name: Adaptability
description: Adjusting quickly to new situations, tasks, tools and priorities, and staying effective when things change.

name: Attention to Detail
description: Working carefully and accurately, checking work thoroughly and noticing small errors or inconsistencies.

name: Customer Service
description: Helping customers before and after a purchase by answering questions, solving problems and handling complaints politely and effectively.
